title: SlotLock
description: A lightweight utility mod that lets you lock inventory slots to prevent accidental dropping or moving of items, featuring a 3x drop protection safety confirmation
body:
# 🔒 Slot Lock

This is a simple mod to lock inventory slots and stop you from losing items by accident! I built this to easily protect your valuable gear and items without needing complex configurations. It features clean visual cues, a padlock icon overlay, and a solid safety confirmation to keep your items safe!

---

*   **Modrinth Profile:** [nicomods on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/user/nicomods)

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔒 **Slot Locking** — Lock and unlock slots with **Ctrl + Left Click** (indicated by a padlock icon overlay).
- 🛡️ **3x Drop Safety** — Safety drop confirmation: you must press Q three times to drop locked items, accompanied by warning messages and sounds.
- 🚫 **Blocked Interactions** — Stops items in locked slots from being moved, quick-moved, or shift-clicked by accident.
- 💾 **Persistent Saving** — Saves your locked slots across player deaths and world reloads so they are always protected.

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

| Requirement | Version |
| :--- | :--- |
| Minecraft Server / Client | **26.1.2** |
| Fabric API | *Required for Fabric version* |
